title: A state label and a process verb occupy different syntactic frames
summary: GDT783 keeps HOT as a portable state minimum while heating-process and preparation-stage rivals remain. The hypothesis predicts a state predicate can attach to a carrier without an operation event.

design.unit: source-bound complete records or visual-text contexts named in source_observation
design.prediction: the same HOT-bearing form should appear with a carrier/state frame lacking an operation/result transition, while a process verb requires an operation/result frame
design.countermodel: This does not reuse HOT/DRY as gold; it tests a frame distinction and leaves the form untranslated.
design.falsifier: HOT-form occurrences systematically require an operation/result frame, or state-frame occurrences require an event marker.
design.principal_risk: No independent operation marker or state measurement; candidate remains raw.

evidence.quote:
## Six explicit candidates and the unresolved dissent

| rank | id | default | axes | clean analogs | external full fields | score | practical spec |
|---:|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | C01_HOT_QUALITY | heiß | `HOT` | 3 | 1 | 10.000000 | 0 |
| 2 | C02_HOT_DRY_QUALITY | heiß und trocken | `HOT|DRY` | 3 | 0 | 4.500000 | 1 |
| 3 | C05_DRY_PREPARATION | Trockenzubereitung | `DRY|PREPARATION` | 1 | 1 | 4.250000 | 0 |
| 4 | C04_HOT_PREPARATION_STAGE | Heißstufe der Zubereitung | `HOT|PREPARATION|STAGE` | 1 | 0 | 2.166667 | 0 |
| 5 | C06_HEATING_PROCESS | Erwärmungsvorgang | `HOT|PROCESS` | 1 | 0 | 1.000000 | 0 |
| 6 | C03_HOT_DRY_MATERIAL | heißgetrocknetes Arzneigut | `HOT|DRY|MATERIAL` | 0 | 0 | -2.166667 | 0 |

The diagnostic score is not a lexical probability. It favors minimum complete
axis coverage and therefore chooses HOT-only. The separate frozen practical
selection retains the still-possible parent HOT|DRY card with split confidence.
Material, preparation-stage and process readings remain published rivals;
`erhitzt` would overstate a process absent from the primary fields.

design.smallest_test: Blindly classify the three source loci and two clean analogs by carrier/state versus operation/result; retain both German-free hypotheses.
design.selection_status: raw_unreviewed; no readiness or novelty claim
